name: CQUniCares Study Resource Equity Bursary
summary: Bursary for First Nations CQUniversity students to help with study resources.
who: First Nations student in an undergraduate or postgraduate course
Studying at least 6 credit points at Term 3, 2026 census
Australian or New Zealand citizen, permanent resident or humanitarian visa holder
Not receiving a Needs-based Funding or ISSP scholarship in the current term
how: Complete the online Equity Scholarship Application Form

source.label: CQUniversity: CQUniCares Study Resource Equity Bursary

evidence.quote: Be a First Nations student enrolled in an undergraduate or postgraduate course
Bursaries are subject to funding availability. Applications will remain open until funding is exhausted.
